## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.35%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND (SPY/TLT ↑ rising) and VXX (1W: -0.68% | 1M: -4.88%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling point to easing fear, while HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND and sector breadth weakness offset those signals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND show tightening credit conditions (HYG/LQD ↓ falling). Fear moderating: VXX (1W: -0.68% | 1M: -4.88%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; Stocks vs Bonds edge favors equities (SPY/TLT ↑ rising).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: UUP (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +1.50%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising dollar with TLT (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling yields, and the yield curve (Level) ↓ falling signals slightly tighter financial conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +15.95%) ABOVE TREND but sector breadth shows Technology 1W negative — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.35%) ABOVE TREND. EM and China lag: EEM (1W: -4.22% | 1M: +4.20%) CORRECTION and FXI (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -2.77%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Cooling speculative risk: Speculation Index ↓ falling; ARKK (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -3.15%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +2.83%) CORRECTION show weaker small-cap/speculative demand, while IBIT (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION signals mixed crypto flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Energy commodities strong: BNO (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +17.54%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +17.79%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals mixed with CPER (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +3.25%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clearly leading: XLE (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +5.10%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.35%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple core ETFs in CORRECTION (QQQ (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +10.69%) CORRECTION, SOXX (1W: -2.26% | 1M: +25.27%) CORRECTION, TLT BELOW TREND) — this MAJOR divergence supports the NEUTRAL reading.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy cyclicals and commodity beneficiaries (XLE (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +17.54%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to rate‑sensitive and defensive assets showing weakness (GLD (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND, XLU (1W: -1.90% | 1M: -5.35%) BELOW TREND) and monitor tech momentum (XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +15.95%) ABOVE TREND but breadth mixed).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy (XLE (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND) if commodity strength persists. BEARISH: Utilities/Defensives (XLU (1W: -1.90% | 1M: -5.35%) BELOW TREND) if rates remain elevated.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil complex (USO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +17.79%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +17.54%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Gold (GLD (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND) while dollar strength persists.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — VXX (1W: -0.68% | 1M: -4.88%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD ~0.74 (credit stress) — HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND, LQD (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND; SPY/TLT 8.8 (risk tilt) — SPY/TLT (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +7.93%) ↑ rising.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Energy (XLE (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND) and cyclicals show relative strength while tech breadth is mixed; key risk is the major divergence between strong 1M leadership and weakening 1W momentum across large-cap tech and semiconductors (QQQ (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +10.69%) CORRECTION, SOXX (1W: -2.26% | 1M: +25.27%) CORRECTION) plus rising credit stress (HYG/LQD).
